competitor.budget_note: One fixed XGBoost fit per split; CTBoost searches 3 or4 fits. Equal per-fit caps are not equal total search cost; this is not exhaustive competitor HPO.

hypothesis: Leaf optimization and validation-selected shrinkage/round budgets may improve loss per stored node while keeping feature tests before cuts. Vector layout alone should preserve predictions exactly.
limitations: Exploratory small bundled real datasets; breast_cancer and digits were used in earlier different40-round studies. New splits overlap older data and are not an independent confirmation panel. No TabArena, Elo, general ranking, or default change claim.

resources.fit_order: Sequential; all CTBoost variants and competitor per case; no simultaneous inference benchmarks

selection.baseline: Default learner controls and learning rate0.05; native validation early stopping selects rounds
selection.compact: Fewest physical nodes among checkpoints within 1% of globally best validation loss; ties prefer lower validation loss, fewer rounds, variant name. This targets topology storage/traversal, not serialized bytes or vector-leaf payload bytes.
selection.quality: Minimum validation loss across all retained/checkpoint CTBoost models; ties prefer fewer physical nodes, then rounds, then variant name

split: 60/20/20 train/validation/test; classification stratified, two predeclared seeds; no test scoring until every choice is frozen
